rationale: Monotonic Volt-VAR curve designed to mitigate voltage violations. At low voltage (0.92-0.95 pu), the curve injects reactive power to raise voltage. At nominal voltage (1.0 pu), no reactive power is commanded. At high voltage (1.05-1.10 pu), the curve absorbs reactive power to lower voltage. All q_fraction values respect inverter reactive-power capability and voltage corrections bring all timesteps within the [0.95, 1.05] pu band.
